verdict.rationale: Antigravity is itself an agentic coding IDE/CLI/SDK that acts as an MCP client—connecting to and consuming external MCP servers (docs-12, docs-14, docs-22, docs-28)—not a service exposing an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role boundary, this axis (being connectable via an official MCP server) is a category error for an agent product and does not apply.
